page_title: ROM 0-1 NAP | AS Roma v Napoli 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Davide Massa is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Davide Massa shows the yellow card to Mathias Olivera (Napoli) for a heavy challenge.
90+6' Flag goes up against Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+3' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) was probably a bit loose with his words to Davide Massa, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+1' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was forced into action to thwart Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
88' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
86' A yellow card for a tackle by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma). Davide Massa doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
86' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
85' Antonio Conte is forced to make a change. David Neres (Napoli) is unable to continue due to injury, Lorenzo Lucca comes on.
84' David Neres (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

84' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
82' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Wesley Franca.
81' The attendance is 63937.
80' Tullio Gritti decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini will be replaced by Leon Bailey (AS Roma).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) replaces Rasmus Hojlund.
77' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
76' Some great play by Matteo Politano (Napoli) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
75' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
73' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Davide Massa didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
71' Matteo Politano (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
69' Substitution. Noa Lang is replaced by Matteo Politano (Napoli).
69' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
68' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. AS Roma get a corner.
66' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Wesley Franca (AS Roma) but poses no threat.
64' Sam Beukema (Napoli) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
63' The foul by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Davide Massa.
62' Tullio Gritti prepares a substitution. Matias Soule is replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
62' Substitution. Bryan Cristante makes way for Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
60' Mile Svilar pulls off a great save to deny Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
59' Manu Kone (AS Roma) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
56' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) for a tough tackle.
53' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes.
51' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Sam Beukema (Napoli) heads on.
49' David Neres (Napoli) takes a short corner kick.
48' Sam Beukema (Napoli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The foul by Mathias Olivera (Napoli) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
46' Tullio Gritti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) replacing Evan Ferguson.
46' Davide Massa blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Matias Soule (AS Roma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The linesman signals that Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
44' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
42' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
39' That's unlucky! David Neres (Napoli) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
36' 0 - 1 Goal! Rasmus Hojlund tees up David Neres (Napoli) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the middle of the net. 0:1.
34' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
33' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner but it's cleared.
30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma). The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.

27' Mile Svilar makes a brilliant save! Noa Lang (Napoli) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
26' David Neres (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
24' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
22' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a comfortable save.
21' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

18' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
17' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece.
16' Matias Soule (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
15' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
14' David Neres (Napoli) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
13' Sam Beukema (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Napoli will take a corner kick.
12' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
11' Good clearance! Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the middle of the net, but Mile Svilar makes a decent save to stop the effort.
8' The linesman raises his flag. Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is adjudged offside.
7' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' David Neres (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
3' Looks like Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' The ball is cleared after Noa Lang (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Davide Massa.
